text:
lina-docs: opened a small PR to sync the audit-log / retention page and add short migration snippets for SDKs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/734

kevin-legal: quick legal flag: pls avoid language like 'retain indefinitely' or 'permanently' in public docs. SOC2 reviewers want explicit scope + exception for legal holds. Recommend: 'Audit logs are retained per customer-configured retention settings; Redwood does not retain logs beyond those settings except to comply with legal obligations (e.g., legal holds).' Also remove direct links to internal playbooks; use '(contact support)' instead.

omar-eng: thanks. small tech note: the SDKs shipped a shape change last week. Examples using top-level `ttl_seconds` are stale. Please use `retention_policy` object and show pseudonymize flag in examples. Example fixes: 
```diff
- client.audit.create(tenant='org_1', ttl_seconds=86400)
+ client.audit.create(tenant='org_1', retention_policy={'mode':'ttl','seconds':86400}, pseudonymize=True)
```
Curl example: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit -d '{"tenant":"org_1","retention_policy":{"mode":"ttl","seconds":86400},"pseudonymize":true}'
```

tess-privacy: that wording from Kevin is fine for the public page. add one short sentence in the examples area noting customers can enable pseudonymization via the API (linked to examples).

lina-docs: will update the prose and examples, remove the internal playbook link and replace it with the support pointer. pushing a tiny commit now.

lina-docs: replaced internal link, updated python/js/curl snippets and added a brief CLI example for customers migrating infra. merging to staging once CI warning clears. thanks all! :tada:
